note: Public reports of a route's rate and its TCE, the anchors the engine is tested against. Figures are the reports' own, with their qualifiers ('just over', 'about'); quote is the text each was read from, in the document named by raw_key. No figure here is tuned or adjusted.

tanker_weekly.about: The Baltic Exchange's weekly tanker roundup, republished in full by Hellenic Shipping News each Monday, gives each route's rate and the Baltic's round-trip TCE for the standard vessel. Rates are Worldscale points except TD22 and TC20, which the Baltic assesses as a lump sum in US dollars. The week ending date is the Friday before publication.

early_march_2026.about: The early March 2026 VLCC rate after the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on 2 March.

items.quote: assessed the rate to carry a 270,000 metric ton cargo of crude from the Persian Gulf to China at $62.07/mt on March 2, up 35% from the previous assessment and up 461% from the start of the year
items.source: Platts, part of S&P Global Energy, as reported by Hellenic Shipping News on 4 March 2026

items.quote: with a Gulf-to-China voyage now costing $89 per metric tonne, up 560% since early January
items.source: Oilprice.com (Tom Kool), republished by Yahoo Finance on 3 March 2026
items.primary_note: The article names no source. No assessment of $89/t was found: Platts printed $62.07/t for 2 March (up 461 percent from the start of the year), and Platts' start of year level ($11.07/t on 2 January) would put a 560 percent rise near $73/t.

items.quote: The Persian Gulf-China benchmark freight rate rose 73.8% to w93 or $19.24/mt by Jan. 13, up from w53.5 or $11.07/mt on Jan. 2, according to Platts data.
items.source: Platts, as reported by Hellenic Shipping News on 17 January 2026

items.quote: This rebound followed a steep decline earlier, when the rate dropped from $27.84/mt on Dec. 12 to $10.03/mt by Jan. 3.
items.source: Platts, as reported by Hellenic Shipping News on 17 January 2026

items.quote: The Platts VLCC index for non-scrubber-fitted, non-eco vessels stood at $294,645/day March 16, retreating from its record high of $519,104/day on March 3, after $208,000/day on Feb. 27
items.source: Platts VLCC index, non-scrubber, non-eco vessels, as reported by Hellenic Shipping News on 19 March 2026

items.quote: The Argus -assessed crude-specific Basrah medium, Mideast Gulf to China VLCC rate surged to $15.32/bl on 3 March, just over 20pc of the fob price for the same grade. This rate stood at $6.82/bl
items.use: context only: a per barrel rate for one grade; converting it to tonnes needs the grade's barrels per tonne, which the article does not give
